RecipeDef.label: install Mining Servitor arm
RecipeDef.description: Installs an augmetic replacement arm designed for the specific role of the mining servitors. Comfort is not a concern for the cybernetic slaves of the Mechanicus, so the fact that the limb stresses the user's pain receptors is considered an irrelevance.
